verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents its own access-review capability: a doc page titled 'Perform Access Review for a Critical System', plus 'Monitor Access Checks' and integrations that map users with access and flag offboarded users. The evidence pack carries only page titles and short snippets, so the workflow details are unproven, and generic evidence-collection claims do not show that review artifacts land in an evidence library. missing for 10: evidence of periodic/scheduled review campaigns, coverage across all connected apps (not just critical systems), in-app reviewer sign-off, automatic filing of the review artifact into the evidence library, independent or hands-on corroboration.
